Niger Junta Claims Control After Reported Coup Attempt

Niger's military junta, led by General Tiani, has claimed to regain control following an attempted coup. Soldiers reportedly attacked the presidency, shaking the nation, which is rich in gold and uranium. The junta stated it was back in control after the incident, and control of a military base was regained.
